concerns.text: Success criterion SC-003 requires the p‑value for the `thread_type` fixed effect to be < 0.05 for the analysis to be considered successful. This makes the hypothesis test itself the pass/fail condition, creating a circular validation of the research question and encouraging p‑hacking. The outcome (statistical significance) must be reported, not used as a prerequisite for “success”.

Principle VI (Measurement Validity) mandates that both the sentiment analysis tool (VADER) and the prosocial‑keyword lexicon be validated on a representative sample. The specification only describes validation of the prosocial keyword counts (Cohen’s Kappa) but provides no validation procedure or performance metric for VADER sentiment scores, violating the measurement‑validity requirement.
